<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>Vale approves Securities Trading Policy</B>
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">Rio de Janeiro, January&nbsp;19, 2011 &#151; Vale S.A. (Vale) announces that its Board of Directors approved
the new Vale&#146;s Securities Trading Policy, which replaces the current policy approved on November
13, 2002.
</DIV>

<DIV align="right" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>For further information, please contact:</B><BR>
&#043;55-21-3814-4540<br>Roberto Castello
Branco: roberto.castello.branco@vale.com<BR>
Viktor Moszkowicz:
viktor.moszkowicz@vale.com<br> Carla Albano
Miller: carla.albano@vale.com<br> Andrea Gutman:
andrea.gutman@vale.com<br> Fernando Frey:
fernando.frey@vale.com<br> Marcio Loures Penna:
marcio.penna@vale.com<br> Samantha Pons:
samantha.pons@vale.com<br> Thomaz Freire:
thomaz.freire@vale.com
</DIV>


<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">This press release may contain statements that express management&#146;s expectations about future
events or results rather than historical facts. These forward-looking statements involve risks and
uncertainties that could cause actual results to differ materially from those projected in
forward-looking statements, and Vale cannot give assurance that such statements will prove correct.
These risks and uncertainties include factors: relating to the Brazilian and Canadian economy and
securities markets, which exhibit volatility and can be adversely affected by developments in other
countries; relating to the iron ore and nickel business and its dependence on the global steel
industry, which is cyclical in nature; and relating to the highly competitive industries in which
Vale operates. For additional information on factors that could cause Vale&#146;s actual results to
differ from expectations reflected in forward-looking statements, please see Vale&#146;s reports filed
with the Brazilian Comiss&#227;o de Valores Mobili&#225;rios and the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission.
</DIV>
<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;

<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Folio -->&nbsp;<!-- /Folio -->
</DIV>

<!-- PAGEBREAK -->
<P><HR noshade><P>
<H5 align="left" style="page-break-before:always"><A HREF="#toc">Table of Contents</A></H5><P>

<DIV style="font-family: Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; margin-left: .25in; width: 7.50in">

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><IMG src="c11241c1124100.gif" alt="(VALE LOGO)">
</DIV>


<DIV align="center" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>SHARE TRADING POLICY</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>INTRODUCTION</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">Vale S.A. (Vale) strongly believes it is praiseworthy to have its employees, directors and officers
holding interest within Vale.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">The decision to invest one&#146;s savings over the long term in the securities issued by Vale, including
stock and their derivatives, and/or debt securities, reflects commitment to and confidence in
Vale&#146;s future.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">However, speculation in Vale-issued securities by its employees, officers and directors produces
the opposite effect. The use of privileged information in the course of speculation in the Vale&#146;s
securities, or for any other purpose, is illegal and detrimental to Vale and its shareholders,
directors and officers and employees.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>1. SCOPE AND PURPOSE</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>1.1. </B>The purpose of Vale&#146;s Securities Trading Policy (&#147;Trading Policy&#148;), developed in accordance
with Instruction No.&nbsp;358/02 issued by the Brazilian Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM)&nbsp;and
Vale&#146;s Code of Ethical Conduct, is to promote the responsible trading of the securities issued by
Vale, or related to them, eliminating any presumption of the inappropriate use of information
relating to a Material Event or Fact (Ato ou Fato Relevante) about Vale (&#147;Privileged Information&#148;).
An Ato or Fato Relevante is an event or a fact that may significantly influence: (i)&nbsp;the market
price of securities issued or guaranteed by Vale or (ii)&nbsp;the decisions of investors to purchase,
sell or retain such said securities, or to exercise any rights they may have regarding such
securities.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>1.2. </B>This Trading Policy also aims to promote compliance with the laws and regulations of the
United States of America and Hong Kong, where Vale&#146;s shares are traded in stock markets in form of
ADRs and HDRs, respectively, which prohibit insider trading/dealing (the use of privileged
information for private benefit), included herein the use of tipping (furnishing of privileged
information to third parties for their own benefit).
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>1.2.1 </B>For purposes of the laws and rules of United States of America, a person engages into
practices of (i)&nbsp;insider trading if he purchases or sells securities holding relevant information
not publicly disclosed (material non-public information) that has been obtained or used in breach
of one&#146;s duty of trust and confidence, and (ii)&nbsp;tipping, by providing such information to a third
party who uses it to commit insider trading.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>1.2.2 </B>For purposes of the laws and rules of Hong Kong, a person engages in practices of insider
trading when, in possession of material non-public information, trades or encourages third parties
to trade with securities issued by Vale, or in case it provides such information to third parties,
knowing, or expecting, that they will trade with Vale&#146;s securities.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>1.3. </B>The Trading Policy applies to: Vale itself; its controlling shareholder, Valepar S.A.
(Valepar); the representatives of the shareholders of Valepar S.A.; the members of the Board of
Directors of Valepar S.A.; the members of the Board of Directors of Vale; the members of the Fiscal
Council of Vale; the members of the Advisory Committees of the Board of Directors of Vale; the
executive officers, global officers, departmental officers, general managers, executive
coordinator,
coordinator, managers, and other employees who are privy to privileged information as a result of
their position or function in Vale or its controlled companies.
</DIV>
<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;

<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Folio -->&nbsp;<!-- /Folio -->
</DIV>

<!-- PAGEBREAK -->
<P><HR noshade><P>
<H5 align="left" style="page-break-before:always"><A HREF="#toc">Table of Contents</A></H5><P>

<DIV style="font-family: Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; margin-left: .25in; width: 7.50in">

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>1.4. </B>Publicly traded companies that are controlled by Vale shall adopt this Trading Policy and
apply, where applicable, the prohibitions and other restrictions established herein.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>1.5. </B>All persons included in item 1.3 above shall be referred to, whether jointly or individually,
as Affected Persons.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>1.6 </B>The prohibitions contained in this Trading Policy comprehend any acquisition, divestiture or
transfer of securities issued or guaranteed by Vale.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>1.7. </B>The rules established in this Trading Policy shall also apply in all cases in which Affected
Persons engage in trading for their direct and/or indirect benefit through the use, for example,
of:
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>(a) </B>companies in which they have direct or indirect control;
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>(b) </B>third parties with whom the
Affected Persons enter into a management agreement (Contrato de Gest&#227;o), trust agreement
(Fideicomisso) or asset management agreement (Contrato de Administra&#231;&#227;o de Carteira de
Investimentos em Ativos Financeiros);
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>(c) </B>attorneys-in-fact or agents; or
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>(d) </B>spouses from whom
the Affected Persons are not legally separated (separados judicialmente); unmarried partners
(companheiros), minor child and any dependents declared in an annual income tax return).
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>1.8.</B>The restrictions listed in item 1.7 above do not apply to trading carried out through
investment funds in which the Affected Persons are shareholders, provided that:
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>(a) </B>the investment
funds are open, non-exclusive funds; and
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>(b) </B>the trading decisions of the investment fund manager
are not influenced by the fund&#146;s shareholders.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>1.9 </B>The Affected Persons shall also ensure, as far as possible, whenever prevented form trading,
that natural persons or corporate entities mentioned in item 1.7, also abstain to do so.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>1.10 </B>The present Trading Policy also applies to any director or officer that may, by any chance, be
discharged of duty before the public disclosure of a business or fact started within their term of
office, and shall extend for the term of six months after its disengagement.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>2. THIRD-PARTY INFORMATION</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>2.1</B>. Affected Persons shall also be prohibited from trading securities issued by Vale if they are
aware of the existence of material non-public information related to any other company that may
affect the price of such securities as indicated in item 1 above, including subsidiaries,
competitors, suppliers and customers of Vale.
</DIV>
<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;

<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Folio -->&nbsp;<!-- /Folio -->
</DIV>

<!-- PAGEBREAK -->
<P><HR noshade><P>
<H5 align="left" style="page-break-before:always"><A HREF="#toc">Table of Contents</A></H5><P>

<DIV style="font-family: Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; margin-left: .25in; width: 7.50in">

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>3. BLACKOUT PERIOD</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>3.1. </B>In addition to the prohibitions on trading set forth in CVM Instruction No.&nbsp;358/02, the
Affected Persons shall not engage in the trading of securities issued by Vale and the publicly
traded companies it controls:
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>(a)&nbsp;</B>during the period that extends from thirty (30)&nbsp;days prior to the disclosure or publication of
the quarterly or annual financial statements of Vale to 2 (two)&nbsp;days after such disclosure or
publication;
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>(b)&nbsp;</B>during the period between and including the decisions of the shareholders of Valepar (i)&nbsp;to
modify Vale&#146;s share capital through stock issuances (subscri&#231;&#227;o de a&#231;&#245;es), (ii)&nbsp;to approve a Vale
share acquisition or divestment program by the company itself; or (iii)&nbsp;to approve dividends or
interest on the company&#146;s capital stock, stock approve, stock derivatives, or share splits; and the
publication of relevant public notices (editais)&nbsp;and/or other press releases; and
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>(c)&nbsp;</B>during any other period designated by Company&#146;s Executive Officer for Investor Relations, upon
prior authorization by the Chairman of Vale&#146;s Board of Directors, as requested by the Chief
Executive Officer.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>4. TRADING AUTHORIZATION</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>4.1. </B>Affected Persons may trade securities issued by Vale, subject to the blackout periods cited
in item 3.1 above, with the objective of long-term investment, provided that this policy
recommends that such securities be held for a minimum period of 6 (six)&nbsp;months.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>5. DISCLOSURE OF INFORMATION OF OFFICER&#146;S BUSINESSES</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>5.1 </B>The members of the Board of Directors, their Advisory Committees, the Executive Officers, and
the members of the Fiscal Council of Vale, shall report, in writing, pursuant to article 11 of the
CVM Instruction No.&nbsp;358/02, to the Executive Officer for Investors Relations and, though him, to
the CVM and to the stock markets where Vale&#146;s securities are listed and traded:
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>(a)&nbsp;</B>the number of securities issued by Vale or its controlled or controlling companies which are
public, that they eventually hold, as well as the number held by their spouses, except if legally
separated or separated in fact, unmarried partners, any dependents declared in an annual income
tax return, and by companies directly or indirectly controlled by them;
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>(b)&nbsp;</B>any change in the trading position referred to above.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>5.2 </B>The report provided for in item 5.1 above shall be made (i)&nbsp;on the first business day after
its investiture; (ii)&nbsp;within the term of five (5)&nbsp;days after the closing of each trade, and
shall contain, at least, the following information:
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>(a)&nbsp;</B>name and personal qualification of the reporting person, indicating his registration
number before the General Taxpayer&#146;s Registry (CPF), if domiciled in Brazil;
</DIV>
<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;

<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Folio -->&nbsp;<!-- /Folio -->
</DIV>

<!-- PAGEBREAK -->
<P><HR noshade><P>
<H5 align="left" style="page-break-before:always"><A HREF="#toc">Table of Contents</A></H5><P>

<DIV style="font-family: Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; margin-left: .25in; width: 7.50in">

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>(b)&nbsp;</B>number, by kind and class, in case of shares, and other characteristics, in case of other
securities, besides the identification of the issuer and the balance of the trading position held
before and after the trade;
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>(c) </B>form, price and date of the transactions;
</DIV>


<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>5.3 </B>The Executive Officer for Investors Relations, in turn, shall report to CVM and the stock
markets the information obtained, individually and in the aggregate, as the case may be, within
ten (10)&nbsp;days after the end of the month in which the changes in the trading position may be
verified, or after the date of investiture in office.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>5.4 </B>The Affected Persons above, shall execute the respective Term of Acceptance (Termo de Ades&#227;o),
pursuant to article 16 of the CVM Instruction No.&nbsp;358/02, in accordance to the template contained
in Exhibit&nbsp;1 of this Trading Policy, that will be kept in file in Vale&#146;s headquarters insofar its
signatory maintains its bond with Vale, and, for five years, at least, after the discharge of his
or her professional duty.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>6. MISCELLANEOUS</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>6.1. </B>Any uncertainties relating to that provided by this Trading Policy, or the application of
any provisions hereof, shall be directly addressed to the Vale&#146;s General Counsel, who shall
provide appropriate clarification or guidance.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>6.2. </B>Any violation of this Trading Policy shall be considered a violation Vale&#146;s Code of Ethical
Conduct and shall be subject to the procedures and penalties established therein, subjecting the
violator to punishments provided by law, in addition to being held responsible for damages caused
to the Vale and third parties.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>6.3. </B>The unauthorized disclosure of material non-public information about Vale is detrimental to
the Company and is strictly prohibited.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>6.4. </B>This Trading Policy has been approved by Vale&#146;s Board of Directors, the only authorized
corporate body which may approve any proposal to amend or revise it.
</DIV>
<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;

<P align="center" style="font-size: 10pt"><!-- Folio -->&nbsp;<!-- /Folio -->
</DIV>

<DIV align="right" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>Securities Trading Policy<BR> (GLOBAL)</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="center" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt"><B>TERM OF ACCEPTANCE</B>
</DIV>


<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">Hereby, Mr. &#091;Name&#093;, &#091;Qualification&#093;, resident and domiciled at &#091;Address&#093;, in the City of &#091;City&#093;,
State of &#091;State&#093;, &#091;Country&#093;, registered before the General Taxpayer&#146;s Registry (CPF)&nbsp;under No.
&#091;CPF&#093;, and bear of the ID No., issued by &#091;Issuing Entity&#093;, hereafter referred to as the &#147;Declaring
Person&#148;, as &#091;Title&#093; of &#091;Entity&#093;, a company with its headquarters at &#091;Address&#093;, in the City of
&#091;City&#093;, State of &#091;State&#093;, registered before the General Taxpayer&#146;s Registry (CNPJ)&nbsp;of the Ministry
of Finance under No. &#091;CNPJ&#093;, declares, subject to the penalty of Law, that has received a copy and
has full knowledge of the contents of Vale&#146;s Securities Trading Policy (the &#147;Trading Policy&#148;),
binding himself, insofar maintaining its liason with Vale S.A. (&#147;Vale&#148;), and, until six (6)&nbsp;months
after divestiture, to observe and guide its actions in accordance to the provisions contained in
such Trading Policy, as well as CVM Instruction n&#186; 358, dated 01/03/2002.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">Declares, furthermore, having full knowledge that any eventual modification in his registration
data, as well as, of the securities issued by Vale or its controlled or controlling entities
publicly traded, or referred, shall be reported, in writing, and in observance to the terms
provided for in the Trading Policy, to the Executive Officer for Investors Relations, without
prejudice to the communication of the other competent bodies.
</DIV>

<DIV align="justify" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">The Declaring Person signs this Term of Acceptance in three (3)&nbsp;originals of identical content, in
the presence of the two (2)&nbsp;witnesses undersigned.
</DIV>

<DIV align="center" style="font-size: 10pt; margin-top: 10pt">Rio de Janeiro, &#091;Date&#093;
</DIV>
